'''afcLogTotals''' is a [[WP:US|user script]] that counts a user's [[WP:AFC|Articles for Creation]] reviews that have been logged by the [[Wikipedia:WikiProject Articles for creation/Helper script#Logging|AFCH script]], and displays accept, decline, and reject totals for each month and for the whole page.

== Benefits ==

Because this script simply parses the users's AfC log, it counts drafts that have been deleted, in contrast to the [https://apersonbot.toolforge.org/afchistory/ afchistory tool] which queries the Wikipedia API.

== Limitations ==

* This script only counts reviews made with the AfC Helper script with logging turned on.
* It only activates on pages named <code>User:<username>/AfC log</code>, not on its subpages (which are recommended for prolific reviewers).

== Installation ==

You can install this script on this Wikipedia by adding the following to your personal [[Special:MyPage/common.js|common.js]] file:

{{tlxs|lusc|User:ClaudineChionh/Scripts/afcLogTotals.js}}

which expands to:

<syntaxhighlight lang="JavaScript">
mw.loader.load("/w/index.php?title=User:ClaudineChionh/Scripts/afcLogTotals.js&action=raw&ctype=text/javascript"); // Backlink: [[User:ClaudineChionh/Scripts/afcLogTotals]]
</syntaxhighlight>

You may need to [[Wikipedia:PURGE|purge your browser's cache]] after saving the page.

== Styling ==

This script loads CSS from [[User:ClaudineChionh/Scripts/afcLogTotals.css]], which is extremely minimalistic because I don't have an eye for design. You can override this in your [[Wikipedia:Customisation#Skins|skin-specific CSS or common.css]] by styling the <code>.afc-review-totals</code> class.
